Across all 14 runs in EXP: 6,398 verified collisions in 45,875,200 proposals, parity classes [1592, 1626, 1624, 1556] (chi-square 2.03 < 7.81), linear-scale unbiased mean log2(mean(Q')) = -74.3238, one-sided 99% Student-t lower bound log2(lcb_lin) = -74.3978 > QDECL = -74.45 (and log-scale 99% bound -74.3987 > -74.45); the one-sided 99.9% Student-t bound (t = 3.852, 13 df) is -74.4326 > -74.45, and QDECL = -74.45 was fixed before the organizer runs by the pre-registered rule: at least 0.01 below the 99.9% bound of the design frozen on private seeds, rounded down to two decimals (one-sided t of the declared value: 4.4397, 13 df, p < 1e-3).
